Hi Everyone - new member here. Interested in the auto-formalization of PDE papers using Lean. Running a few projects using Claude code, which I hope will be of interest to the community. One of the projects is a Lean dependency explorer that can automatically export statement dependencies to LaTeX (see screenshot at the end), and the other is the full formalization of one of my papers. I hope to release them soon. Quick question: what is the best way to announce those here? Also, if you would like to test the lean dependencies projects, let me know, as I would like to get some feedback before releasing them.
Best,
Diogo
